original: 11. Kevaṭṭasuttaṃ
content: 長部11經/給哇得經(戒蘊品[第一])(莊春江譯)[DA.24]

original: Kevaṭṭagahapatiputtavatthu
content: 屋主之子給哇得的事

original: 481. Evaṃ me sutaṃ– ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
content: [[evaṃ me sutaṃ#被我這麼聽聞]]：[[ekaṃ samayaṃ#有一次]]，[[bhagavā#世尊]]住在那難陀賣衣者的芒果園中。

original: Atha kho kevaṭṭo gahapatiputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami;
content: 那時，屋主之子給哇得去見世尊。

original: upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
content: 抵達後，向世尊[[abhivādetvā#問訊]]後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kevaṭṭo gahapatiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca–
content: 在一旁坐下的屋主之子給哇得對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ ayaṃ, bhante, nāḷandā iddhā ceva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā bhagavati abhippasannā.
content: 「[[bhante#大德]]！這那爛陀是繁榮的，同時也富裕的，以及人多的、人雜亂的、在世尊上[[pasannaṃ#極淨信的]]，

original: Sādhu, bhante, bhagavā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ samādisatu, yo uttarimanussadhammā, iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati;
content: 大德！請世尊指示一位比丘作[[uttarimanussadhammaṃ#過人法]]的神通神變，[[sādhu#那就好了]]！

original: evāyaṃ nāḷandā bhiyyoso mattāya bhagavati abhippasīdissatī’’ ti.
content: 這那爛陀在世尊上將更多量地極淨信。」

original: Evaṃ vutte, bhagavā kevaṭṭaṃ gahapatiputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 在這麼說時，世尊對屋主之子給哇得說這個：

original: ‘‘ na kho ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desemi– etha tumhe, bhikkhave, gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karothā’’ ti.
content: 「給哇得！我不對比丘們教導這樣的法：『比丘們！來！請你們對[[gihī odātavasano#白衣在家人]]作過人法的神通神變。』」(481)

original: 482. Dutiyampi kho kevaṭṭo gahapatiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca–
content: 第二次，屋主之子給哇得又對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ nāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dhaṃsemi;
content: 「大德！我非攻擊世尊，

original: api ca, evaṃ vadāmi–
content: 而是，我這麼說：

original: ‘ ayaṃ, bhante, nāḷandā iddhā ceva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā bhagavati abhippasannā.
content: 『大德！這那爛陀是繁榮的，同時也富裕的，以及人多的、人雜亂的、在世尊上極淨信的，

original: Sādhu, bhante, bhagavā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ samādisatu, yo uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati;
content: 大德！請世尊指示一位比丘作過人法的神通神變，那就好了！

original: evāyaṃ nāḷandā bhiyyoso mattāya bhagavati abhippasīdissatī’’’ ti.
content: 這那爛陀在世尊上將更多量地極淨信。』」

original: Dutiyampi kho bhagavā kevaṭṭaṃ gahapatiputtaṃ etadavoca–
content: 第二次，世尊又對屋主之子給哇得說這個：

original: ‘‘ na kho ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desemi– etha tumhe, bhikkhave, gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karothā’’’ ti.
content: 「給哇得！我不對比丘們教導這樣的法：『比丘們！來！請你們對白衣在家人作過人法的神通神變。』」

original: Tatiyampi kho kevaṭṭo gahapatiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca–
content: 第三次，屋主之子給哇得又對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ nāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dhaṃsemi;
content: 「大德！我非攻擊世尊，

original: api ca, evaṃ vadāmi–
content: 而是，我這麼說：

original: ‘ ayaṃ, bhante, nāḷandā iddhā ceva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā bhagavati abhippasannā.
content: 『大德！這那爛陀是繁榮的，同時也富裕的，以及人多的、人雜亂的、在世尊上極淨信的，

original: Sādhu, bhante, bhagavā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ samādisatu, yo uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati.
content: 大德！請世尊指示一位比丘作過人法的神通神變，那就好了！

original: Evāyaṃ nāḷandā bhiyyoso mattāya bhagavati abhippasīdissatī’ ti.
content: 這那爛陀在世尊上將更多量地極淨信。』」(482)

original: Iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ
content: 神通神變

original: 483.‘‘ Tīṇi kho imāni, kevaṭṭa, pāṭihāriyāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni.
content: 「給哇得！有這三種神變被我以證智自作證後宣說，哪三種？

original: Katamāni tīṇi?
content: 哪三種？

original: Iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ, ādesanāpāṭihāriyaṃ , anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ.
content: 神通神變、讀心(記心)神變、[[iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ#教誡神變]]。(483)

original: 484.‘‘ Katamañca, kevaṭṭa, iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ?
content: 給哇得！而什麼是神通神變呢？

original: Idha, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti.
content: 給哇得！這裡，比丘體驗各種神通種類：

original: Ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti;
content: 是一個後變成多個，又，是多個後變成一個；

original: āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuṭṭaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse;
content: 現身、隱身、穿牆、穿壘、穿山無阻礙地行走猶如在虛空中；

original: pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake;
content: 在地中作浮沈猶如在水中，

original: udakepi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathāpi pathaviyaṃ;
content: 又，在不被破裂的水上行走猶如在地上；

original: ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo;
content: 在空中以盤腿來去猶如有翅膀的鳥，

original: imepi candimasūriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjati;
content: 又，以手碰觸、撫摸這些這麼大神通力、這麼大威力的日月；

original: yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
content: 以身體行使自在直到梵天世界。

original: ‘ ‘ Tamenaṃ aññataro saddho pasanno passati taṃ bhikkhuṃ anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhontaṃ– ekopi hutvā bahudhā hontaṃ, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hontaṃ;
content: 某位對那個有信者、[[pasannaṃ#淨信者]]看見那位比丘正體驗著各種神通種類：是一個後變成多個，又，是多個後變成一個；

original: āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ;
content: 現身、隱身、

original: tirokuṭṭaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamānaṃ gacchantaṃ seyyathāpi ākāse;
content: 穿牆、穿壘、穿山無阻礙地行走猶如在虛空中；

original: pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karontaṃ seyyathāpi udake;
content: 在地中作浮沈猶如在水中，

original: udakepi abhijjamāne gacchantaṃ seyyathāpi pathaviyaṃ;
content: 又，在不被破裂的水上行走猶如在地上；

original: ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamantaṃ seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo;
content: 在空中以盤腿來去猶如有翅膀的鳥，

original: imepi candimasūriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasantaṃ parimajjantaṃ yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vattentaṃ.
content: 又，以手碰觸、撫摸這些這麼大神通力、這麼大威力的日月；以身體行使自在直到梵天世界。

original: ‘ ‘ Tamenaṃ so saddho pasanno aññatarassa assaddhassa appasannassa āroceti–
content: 那位對那個有信者、淨信者告訴某位無信者、無淨信者：

original: ‘ acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
content: 『實在不可思議啊，先生！實在[[abbhuta#未曾有]]啊，先生！沙門的大神通力狀態、大威力狀態：

original: Amāhaṃ bhikkhuṃ addasaṃ anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhontaṃ– ekopi hutvā bahudhā hontaṃ, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hontaṃ… pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vattentan’ ti.
content: 那個我看見比丘正體驗著各種神通種類：有了一個後變成多個，有了多個後變成一個……（中略）以身體行使自在直到梵天世界。』

original: ‘ ‘ Tamenaṃ so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyya–
content: 那位對那個無信者、無淨信者會對那位有信者、淨信者這麼說：

original: ‘ atthi kho, bho, gandhārī nāma vijjā.
content: 『先生！有名叫見達哩的咒(明)，

original: Tāya so bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti– ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti… pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vattetī’ ti.
content: 以那個，那位比丘體驗各種神通種類：有了一個後變成多個，有了多個後變成一個……（中略）以身體行使自在直到梵天世界。』

original: ‘ ‘ Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kevaṭṭa, api nu so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyyā’’ ti?
content: 給哇得！你怎麼想它：是否那位對那個無信者、無淨信者會對那位有信者、淨信者這麼說呢？」

original: ‘‘ Vadeyya, bhante’’ ti.
content: 「大德！會說。」

original: ‘‘ Imaṃ kho ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, iddhipāṭihāriye ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno iddhipāṭihāriyena aṭṭīyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi’’.
content: 「給哇得！看見在神通神變上這個[[ādīnavo#過患]]的我以神通神變厭惡、羞恥、嫌惡。(484)

original: Ādesanāpāṭihāriyaṃ
content: 讀心神變

original: 485.‘‘ Katamañca, kevaṭṭa, ādesanāpāṭihāriyaṃ?
content: 給哇得！而什麼是讀心神變呢？

original: Idha, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cittampi ādisati, cetasikampi ādisati, vitakkitampi ādisati, vicāritampi ādisati–
content: 給哇得！這裡，比丘告知其他眾生、其他個人的心，也告知心所，也告知所尋思的，也告知所伺察的：

original: ‘ evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittan’ ti.
content: 『你的意是這樣，及你的意是像這樣，及你的心是像這樣。』

original: ‘ ‘ Tamenaṃ aññataro saddho pasanno passati taṃ bhikkhuṃ parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cittampi ādisantaṃ, cetasikampi ādisantaṃ, vitakkitampi ādisantaṃ, vicāritampi ādisantaṃ–
content: 某位對那個有信者、淨信者看見那位比丘告知其他眾生、其他個人的心，也告知心所，也告知所尋思的，也告知所伺察的：

original: ‘ evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittan’ ti.
content: 『你的意是這樣，及你的意是像這樣，及你的心是像這樣。』

original: Tamenaṃ so saddho pasanno aññatarassa assaddhassa appasannassa āroceti–
content: 那位對那個有信者、淨信者告訴某位無信者、無淨信者：

original: ‘ acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
content: 『實在不可思議啊，先生！實在未曾有啊，先生！沙門的大神通力狀態、大威力狀態：

original: Amāhaṃ bhikkhuṃ addasaṃ parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cittampi ādisantaṃ, cetasikampi ādisantaṃ, vitakkitampi ādisantaṃ, vicāritampi ādisantaṃ–
content: 那個我看見比丘告知其他眾生、其他個人的心，也告知心所，也告知所尋思的，也告知所伺察的：

original: ‘‘ evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittan’’’ ti.
content: 「你的意是這樣，及你的意是像這樣，及你的心是像這樣。」』

original: ‘ ‘ Tamenaṃ so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyya–
content: 那位對那個無信者、無淨信者會對那位有信者、淨信者這麼說：

original: ‘ atthi kho, bho, maṇikā nāma vijjā;
content: 『先生！有名叫摩尼葛的咒，

original: tāya so bhikkhu parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cittampi ādisati, cetasikampi ādisati, vitakkitampi ādisati, vicāritampi ādisati–
content: 以那個，那位比丘知其他眾生、其他個人的心，也告知心所，也告知所尋思的，也告知所伺察的：

original: ‘ evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittan’’’ ti.
content: 「你的意是這樣，及你的意是像這樣，及你的心是像這樣。」』

original: ‘ ‘ Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kevaṭṭa, api nu so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyyā’’ ti ?
content: 給哇得！你怎麼想它：是否那位對那個無信者、無淨信者會對那位有信者、淨信者這麼說呢？」

original: ‘‘ Vadeyya, bhante’’ ti.
content: 「大德！會說。」

original: ‘‘ Imaṃ kho ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, ādesanāpāṭihāriye ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno ādesanāpāṭihāriyena aṭṭīyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi’’.
content: 「給哇得！看見在讀心神變上這個過患的我以讀心神變厭惡、羞恥、嫌惡。(485)

original: Anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ
content: 教誡神變

original: 486.‘‘ Katamañca, kevaṭṭa, anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ?
content: 給哇得！而什麼是教誡神變呢？

original: Idha, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu evamanusāsati–
content: 給哇得！這裡，比丘這麼教誡：

original: ‘ evaṃ vitakketha, mā evaṃ vitakkayittha, evaṃ manasikarotha, mā evaṃ manasākattha, idaṃ pajahatha, idaṃ upasampajja viharathā’ ti.
content: 『你們要這麼尋思，你們不要這麼尋思；你們要這麼作意，你們不要這麼作意；你們要捨斷這個，你們要[[upasampajja viharanti#進入後住於]]這個。』

original: Idaṃ vuccati, kevaṭṭa, anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ.
content: 給哇得！這被稱為教誡神變。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, kevaṭṭa, idha tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho … pe…( yathā190-212 anucchedesu evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).
content: 再者，給哇得！這裡，[[tathāgato#如來]]、[[arahaṃ#阿羅漢]]、[[sammāsambuddhaṃ#遍正覺者]]……在世間出現……（中略）(在簡略中應該如同190-212[DN.2「更勝妙的沙門果」段落]使之被細說)

original: Evaṃ kho, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti… pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
content: 給哇得！這樣，比丘是戒具足者。……（中略）進入後住於初禪，

original: Idampi vuccati, kevaṭṭa, anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ… pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ… pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ… pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
content: 給哇得！這被稱為教誡神變。……（中略）第二禪……（中略）的第三禪……（中略）進入後住於第四禪，

original: Idampi vuccati, kevaṭṭa, anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ… pe… ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti… pe… idampi vuccati, kevaṭṭa, anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ… pe… nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti… pe… idampi vuccati, kevaṭṭa, anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ.
content: 給哇得！這被稱為教誡神變。……（中略）他抽出心使轉向[[ñāṇadassanaṃ, ñāṇañca…dassanaṃ#智與見]]……（中略）給哇得！這被稱為教誡神變。他知道：『[[khīṇā jāti#出生已盡]]，[[vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ#梵行已完成]]，[[kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ#應該被作的已作]]，[[punabbhava#不再有此處[輪迴]的狀態]]。』給哇得！這也被稱為教誡神變。

original: ‘ ‘ Imāni kho, kevaṭṭa, tīṇi pāṭihāriyāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni’’.
content: 給哇得！這三種神變被我以證智自作證後宣說。(486)

original: Bhūtanirodhesakabhikkhuvatthu
content: 大種滅尋求者比丘的事

original: 487.‘‘ Bhūtapubbaṃ, kevaṭṭa, imasmiññeva bhikkhusaṅghe aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi–
content: 給哇得！從前，就在這個比丘[[saṅgha#僧團]]中，某位比丘這樣心的深思生起：

original: ‘ kattha nu kho ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’ ti?
content: 『這[[cātummahābhūta#四大]]，即：地界、水界、火界、風界在哪裡無餘滅呢？』(487)

original: 488.‘‘ Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajji, yathāsamāhite citte devayāniyo maggo pāturahosi.
content: 給哇得！那時，那位比丘進入像這樣的定，如是，在定中心中出現使至天的道路。

original: Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu yena cātumahārājikā devā tenupasaṅkami;
content: 給哇得！那時，那位比丘去見四大王天的天神們，

original: upasaṅkamitvā cātumahārājike deve etadavoca–
content: 抵達後，對四大王天的天神們說這個：

original: ‘ kattha nu kho, āvuso, ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’ ti?
content: 『[[āvuso#朋友]]們！這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界在哪裡無餘滅呢？』

original: ‘ ‘ Evaṃ vutte, kevaṭṭa, cātumahārājikā devā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocuṃ–
content: 給哇得！在這麼說時，四大王天的天神們對那位比丘說這個：

original: 492.‘‘ Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu yena vasavattī devaputto tenupasaṅkami;

original: ‘ ahampi kho, bhikkhu, na jānāmi yatthime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātūti.

original: 493.‘‘ Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajji, yathāsamāhite citte brahmayāniyo maggo pāturahosi.
content: 給哇得！那時，那位比丘入像這樣的定，如是，在定中心中出現使至梵天的道路，

original: Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu yena brahmakāyikā devā tenupasaṅkami;
content: 給哇得！那時，那位比丘去見梵眾天的天神們，

original: upasaṅkamitvā brahmakāyike deve etadavoca–
content: 抵達後，對梵眾天的天神們說這個：

original: ‘ kattha nu kho, āvuso, ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’ ti?
content: 『朋友們！這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界在哪裡無餘滅呢？』

original: Atthi kho, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānaṃ amhehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
content: 比丘！有梵天、大梵天、征服者、不被征服者、[[aññadatthudaso#全見者]]、[[vasavattī#自在者]]、[[issara#主宰者]]、作者、化作者、最上的創造者、操縱者、已生者與能被出生者之父，是比我們更優勝者與更勝妙者，

original: So kho etaṃ jāneyya, yatthime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’’ ti.
content: 他應該知道這個：這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界，無殘餘地被滅之處。』

original: ‘ ‘‘ Kahaṃ panāvuso, etarahi so mahābrahmā’ ti?
content: 『朋友們！那麼，現在那位大梵天在哪裡？』

original: ‘ Mayampi kho, bhikkhu, na jānāma, yattha vā brahmā yena vā brahmā yahiṃ vā brahmā;
content: 『比丘！我們也不知道梵天之處，或去梵天之處，或梵天在哪裡，

original: api ca, bhikkhu, yathā nimittā dissanti, āloko sañjāyati, obhāso pātubhavati, brahmā pātubhavissati, brahmuno hetaṃ pubbanimittaṃ pātubhāvāya, yadidaṃ āloko sañjāyati, obhāso pātubhavatī’ ti.
content: 比丘！但如是諸相被看見：光明被生，光亮出現，梵天將出現，因為這是梵天出現的前相，即：光明被生，光亮出現。』

original: Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, mahābrahmā nacirasseva pāturahosi .
content: 給哇得！那時，那位大梵天不久就出現。(493)

original: 494.‘‘ Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu yena so mahābrahmā tenupasaṅkami;

original: upasaṅkamitvā taṃ mahābrahmānaṃ etadavoca–

original: ‘ kattha nu kho, āvuso, ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’’ ti?
content: 『朋友！這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界在哪裡無餘滅呢？』

original: ‘ ahamasmi, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānan’ ti.
content: 『比丘！我是梵天、大梵天、征服者、不被征服者、全見者、自在者、主宰者、作者、化作者、最上的創造者、操縱者、已生者與能被出生者之父。』

original: ‘ ‘ Dutiyampi kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu taṃ mahābrahmānaṃ etadavoca–

original: ‘ na khohaṃ taṃ, āvuso, evaṃ pucchāmi–
content: 『朋友！我不這麼問你：

original: ‘‘ tvamasi brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānan’’ ti.
content: 「你是梵天、大梵天、征服者、不被征服者、全見者、自在者、主宰者、作者、化作者、最上的創造者、操縱者、已生者與能被出生者之父。」

original: ‘‘ kattha nu kho, āvuso, ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’’’ ti?
content: 「朋友！這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界在哪裡無餘滅呢？」』

original: ‘ ‘ Dutiyampi kho so, kevaṭṭa, mahābrahmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca–
content: 給哇得！第二次，那位大梵天又對那位比丘說這個：

original: ‘ ahamasmi, bhikkhu, brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānan’ ti.
content: 『比丘！我是梵天、大梵天、征服者、不被征服者、全見者、自在者、主宰者、作者、化作者、最上的創造者、操縱者、已生者與能被出生者之父。』

original: Tatiyampi kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu taṃ mahābrahmānaṃ etadavoca–
content: 給哇得！第三次，那位比丘又對那位大梵天說這個：

original: ‘ na khohaṃ taṃ, āvuso, evaṃ pucchāmi–

original: ‘‘ tvamasi brahmā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sajitā vasī pitā bhūtabhabyānan’’ ti.
content: 「你是梵天、大梵天、征服者、不被征服者、全見者、自在者、主宰者、作者、化作者、最上的創造者、操縱者、已生者與能被出生者之父。」

content: 「朋友！這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界在哪裡無餘滅呢？」』(494)

original: 495.‘‘ Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, mahābrahmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ apanetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca –
content: 給哇得！那時，那位大梵天在手臂捉住那位比丘後，離開在一旁後，對那位比丘說這個：

original: ‘ ime kho maṃ, bhikkhu, brahmakāyikā devā evaṃ jānanti,‘‘ natthi kiñci brahmuno aññātaṃ, natthi kiñci brahmuno adiṭṭhaṃ, natthi kiñci brahmuno aviditaṃ, natthi kiñci brahmuno asacchikatan’’ ti.
content: 『比丘！這些梵眾天的天神們這麼知道我：「沒有任何梵天不知道的，沒有任何梵天沒見過的，沒有任何梵天未發現的，沒有任何梵天未作證的。」

original: Tasmāhaṃ tesaṃ sammukhā na byākāsiṃ.
content: 因此，我在他們的面前不回答。

original: Ahampi kho, bhikkhu, na jānāmi yatthime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātūti.
content: 比丘！我也不知道這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界無殘餘地被滅之處，

original: Tasmātiha, bhikkhu, tuyhevetaṃ dukkaṭaṃ, tuyhevetaṃ aparaddhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ atidhāvitvā bahiddhā pariyeṭṭhiṃ āpajjasi imassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇāya.
content: 比丘！因此，在這裡，這就是你的惡作，這就是你的罪過：凡你越過那位世尊後，在外面來到遍求這個問題的解答。

original: Gaccha tvaṃ, bhikkhu, tameva bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā imaṃ pañhaṃ puccha, yathā ca te bhagavā byākaroti, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāsī’ ti.
content: 比丘！請你去，就去見那位世尊後，請你問這個問題，而你應該如世尊為你解答那樣[[dhāreti#憶持]]它。』(495)

original: 496.‘‘ Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu– seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evameva brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.
content: 給哇得！那時，那位比丘就猶如有力氣的男子伸直彎曲的手臂，或彎曲伸直的手臂，就像這樣在梵天世界消失，出現在我的面前。

original: Atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho, kevaṭṭa, so bhikkhu maṃ etadavoca–
content: 給哇得！那時，那位比丘向我問訊後，在一旁坐下。給哇得！在一旁坐下的那位比丘對我說這個：

original: ‘ kattha nu kho, bhante, ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’ ti?
content: 『大德！這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界在哪裡無餘滅呢？』(496)

original: Tīradassisakuṇupamā
content: 尋岸鳥的譬喻

original: 497.‘‘ Evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ–
content: 給哇得！在這麼說時，我對那位比丘說這個：

original: ‘ bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhu, sāmuddikā vāṇijā tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ gahetvā nāvāya samuddaṃ ajjhogāhanti.
content: 『比丘！從前，航海的商人們取[[tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ#尋岸鳥]]後，以船進入海洋，

original: Te atīradakkhiniyā nāvāya tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ muñcanti.
content: 在未看見岸時，他們釋放尋岸鳥。

original: So gacchateva puratthimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ, gacchati uddhaṃ disaṃ, gacchati anudisaṃ.
content: 牠就走到東方，走到南方，走到西方，走到北方，走到上方，走到四方的中間方。

original: Sace so samantā tīraṃ passati, tathāgatakova[ tathāpakkantova( syā.)] hoti.
content: 如果牠無論在何處看見岸，就成為像這樣去者。

original: Sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati, tameva nāvaṃ paccāgacchati.
content: 但如果牠無論在何處沒看見岸，就返回那艘船[AN.6.54]。

original: Evameva kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, yato yāva brahmalokā pariyesamāno imassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ nājjhagā, atha mamaññeva santike paccāgato.
content: 同樣的，比丘！當你直到梵天世界為止遍求這個問題的解答未得到時，那時，就返回在我的面前。

original: Na kho eso, bhikkhu, pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo–
content: 比丘！這個問題不應該被這麼問：

original: ‘ kattha nu kho, bhante, ime cattāro mahābhūtā aparisesā nirujjhanti, seyyathidaṃ– pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’ ti?
content: 「大德！這四大，即：地界、水界、火界、風界在哪裡無餘滅呢？」(497)

original: 498.‘‘ Evañca kho eso, bhikkhu, pañho pucchitabbo–
content: 比丘！而這個問題應該被這麼問：

original: ‘ Kattha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati;
content: 「在哪裡水與地，火與風不堅立(堅固站立)？

original: Kattha dīghañca rassañca, aṇuṃ thūlaṃ subhāsubhaṃ;
content: 在哪裡長與短，細粗、淨不淨，

original: Kattha nāmañca rūpañca, asesaṃ uparujjhatī’ ti.
content: 在哪裡名與色，被破滅無餘？」(498)

original: 499.‘‘ Tatra veyyākaraṇaṃ bhavati–
content: 在那裡，解答是：

original: ‘ Viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ, anantaṃ sabbatopabhaṃ;
content: 「識是不顯現的，無邊的、[[viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ#全面光明的]][MN.49]，

original: Ettha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati.
content: 在這裡水與地，火、風不堅立。

original: Ettha dīghañca rassañca, aṇuṃ thūlaṃ subhāsubhaṃ;
content: 在這裡長與短，細粗、淨不淨，

original: Ettha nāmañca rūpañca, asesaṃ uparujjhati;
content: 在這裡名與色，被破滅無餘，

original: Viññāṇassa nirodhena, etthetaṃ uparujjhatī’ ti.
content: 以識的滅，在這裡這個被破滅。」』」(499)

original: 500. Idamavoca bhagavā.
content: 世尊說這個，

original: Attamano kevaṭṭo gahapatiputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
content: 悅意的屋主之子給哇得歡喜世尊的所說。(500)

original: Kevaṭṭasuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ ekādasamaṃ.
content: 給哇得經第十一終了。
